questions.question: Which company's logo is a "swoosh"?
questions.fact: The swoosh was designed in 1971 by student Carolyn Davidson, who was paid $35 for it.

questions.question: Which brand has three stripes as its trademark?
questions.fact: Adidas's name comes from its founder, Adolf "Adi" Dassler. His brother Rudolf founded Puma.

questions.question: Which fashion brand did Amancio Ortega found in Galicia?
questions.fact: Zara opened its first shop in A Coruña in 1975. Its owner company, Inditex, is one of the world's biggest fashion groups.

questions.question: Which Spanish fashion brand was founded in Barcelona in 1984?
questions.fact: Mango was founded by brothers Isak and Nahman Andic, and its first shop was on Passeig de Gràcia in Barcelona.

questions.question: Which Swedish company sells flat-pack furniture?
questions.fact: IKEA comes from founder Ingvar Kamprad's initials plus his farm, Elmtaryd, and village, Agunnaryd.

questions.question: Which car brand's logo is four linked rings?
questions.fact: The four rings stand for four German car companies that joined together in 1932: Audi, DKW, Horch and Wanderer.

questions.question: Which of these car brands is from Spain?
questions.fact: SEAT was founded in 1950, and its name stands for Sociedad Española de Automóviles de Turismo.

questions.question: SEAT belongs to which car group?
questions.fact: SEAT joined the Volkswagen Group in the 1980s. Its sporty brand Cupra became a separate brand in 2018.

questions.question: Which car brand's logo is a black prancing horse on yellow?
questions.fact: The prancing horse was painted on the plane of Italian WWI pilot Francesco Baracca; his mother suggested Ferrari use it.

questions.question: Which animal is on the Lamborghini logo?
questions.fact: Ferruccio Lamborghini's star sign was Taurus, and many Lamborghini models are named after famous fighting bulls.

questions.question: Which chain sells the "Big Mac"?
questions.fact: The Big Mac was created in 1967 by a McDonald's franchise owner in Pittsburgh.

questions.question: What is Burger King's most famous burger called?
questions.fact: The Whopper was created in 1957 and sold for 37 cents.

questions.question: Which fast-food chain is famous for its colonel?
questions.fact: Colonel Harland Sanders was an honorary "Kentucky colonel", not a military one. He started selling chicken in the 1930s.

questions.question: Which coffee chain has a green two-tailed siren as its logo?
questions.fact: Starbucks is named after a character in the novel Moby-Dick. Its first shop opened in Seattle in 1971.

questions.question: Which drink was first sold as a medicine in Atlanta in 1886?
questions.fact: Coca-Cola was invented by pharmacist John Pemberton. In its first year it sold only about nine drinks a day.

questions.question: Which company makes Kit Kat outside the USA?
questions.fact: Kit Kat was first made by Rowntree's in York, England, in 1935. Japan has had hundreds of flavours.

questions.question: Which Spanish lollipop brand has a logo designed by Salvador Dalí?
questions.fact: Chupa Chups was founded in 1958 by Enric Bernat in Catalonia, and Dalí sketched its daisy logo in 1969.

questions.question: The name "Haribo" comes from…
questions.fact: Hans Riegel founded Haribo in Bonn in 1920, and he invented the gummy bear soon after.

questions.question: LEGO comes from which country?
questions.fact: LEGO comes from the Danish "leg godt", meaning "play well".

questions.question: Which brand's slogan is "Just Do It"?
questions.fact: "Just Do It" first appeared in a Nike advert in 1988.

questions.question: "I'm lovin' it" is the slogan of…
questions.fact: "I'm lovin' it" launched in 2003 and was first released in German as "ich liebe es".

questions.question: Which Italian company makes Nutella?
questions.fact: Nutella grew out of a hazelnut paste made in Italy after WWII, when cocoa was scarce and expensive.

questions.question: Which Japanese car brand makes the Corolla?
questions.fact: The Corolla is the best-selling car model ever, with over 50 million sold.

questions.question: Which company makes the modern Mini?
questions.fact: The original Mini was a British car from 1959. BMW makes the modern version, launched in 2001.

questions.question: Which company makes the Model 3 electric car?
questions.fact: Tesla is named after the inventor Nikola Tesla.

questions.question: Which luxury brand's logo is two interlocking Cs?
questions.fact: Coco Chanel created the interlocking Cs, and the famous Chanel No. 5 perfume came out in 1921.

questions.question: Which figure from Greek myth is in the Versace logo?
questions.fact: Gianni Versace said he chose Medusa because people who fell in love with her could never escape.

questions.question: Which Spanish luxury leather brand was founded in Madrid in 1846?
questions.fact: Loewe started as a workshop of leather craftsmen in Madrid and later became a supplier to the Spanish royal family.

questions.question: Which Basque designer founded a famous fashion house in Paris?
questions.fact: Balenciaga was born in Getaria, Gipuzkoa, where a museum about his work now stands.

questions.question: Which company owns Instagram and WhatsApp?
questions.fact: Facebook renamed its parent company Meta in 2021, to focus on the "metaverse".

questions.question: Which famous doll was launched in 1959?
questions.fact: Barbie's full name is Barbara Millicent Roberts. She was named after the creator's daughter, Barbara.

questions.question: Which company created Mickey Mouse?
questions.fact: Mickey Mouse first appeared in the 1928 cartoon "Steamboat Willie", with Walt Disney doing his voice.

questions.question: Which brand makes "Air Jordan" trainers?
questions.fact: The first Air Jordan was made for basketball star Michael Jordan in 1985.

questions.question: Which quirky shoe brand comes from Mallorca?
questions.fact: Camper comes from Inca, Mallorca, where the founder's grandfather started making shoes in 1877.

questions.question: Which is the biggest supermarket chain in Spain?
questions.fact: Mercadona was founded in Valencia in 1977. Its own-brand label is Hacendado.

questions.question: Lidl comes from which country?
questions.fact: Lidl and Aldi are both German discount chains. Lidl opened its first shop in Spain in 1994.

questions.question: Carrefour comes from which country?
questions.fact: Carrefour opened in 1959, and it's credited with opening one of the first hypermarkets in France in 1963.

questions.question: Michelin, famous for restaurant stars, mainly makes…
questions.fact: The Michelin Guide began in 1900 as a free booklet to encourage people to drive more and wear out their tyres.

questions.question: Which Swiss watch brand has a crown as its logo?
questions.fact: Rolex was founded in London in 1905 and later moved to Geneva.

questions.question: Which Danish beer claims to be "probably the best beer in the world"?
questions.fact: Carlsberg was named after the founder's son, Carl. The famous slogan has been used since the 1970s.

questions.question: Heineken comes from which country?
questions.fact: Heineken was founded in Amsterdam in 1864 and is sold in almost every country in the world.

questions.question: Which beer is Barcelona's best-known local brand?
questions.fact: Estrella Damm was first brewed in 1876 by August Kuentzmann Damm, who moved to Barcelona from Alsace.

questions.question: Mahou beer comes from which Spanish city?
questions.fact: Mahou was founded in Madrid in 1890. Its classic red-label beer is "Cinco Estrellas".

questions.question: Which sparkling mineral water from France comes in a green bottle?
questions.fact: Perrier comes from a spring in the south of France, and its famous bottle shape is said to be based on Indian clubs used for exercise.

questions.question: Which Korean company makes OLED TVs alongside Samsung?
questions.fact: LG's name comes from two earlier brands: Lucky and GoldStar.

questions.question: Which camera brand is famous for instant photos?
questions.fact: Polaroid's inventor, Edwin Land, reportedly got the idea when his daughter asked why she couldn't see a photo right away.

questions.question: Which company makes the 911 sports car?
questions.fact: The Porsche 911 has been made since 1963, and it still looks a lot like the original.

questions.question: Which pizza chain's logo is a domino?
questions.fact: The three dots on Domino's logo stood for its first three shops; the plan was to add a dot for each new shop.

questions.question: Telepizza was founded in which country?
questions.fact: Telepizza opened its first shop in Madrid in 1987.

questions.question: Which airline is Spain's flag carrier?
questions.fact: Iberia was founded in 1927 and is one of the oldest airlines in the world still flying.

questions.question: Vueling's main base is at which airport?
questions.fact: Vueling started flying in 2004 and is now part of the same group as Iberia and British Airways.

questions.question: Ryanair comes from which country?
questions.fact: Ryanair was founded in 1984 and grew into one of Europe's biggest airlines by passengers.

questions.question: Which company makes the Kindle e-reader?
questions.fact: The first Kindle came out in 2007 and sold out in just a few hours.

questions.question: Which Swiss chocolate comes in a triangular bar?
questions.fact: Toblerone's shape is often linked to the Matterhorn mountain, and a bear is hidden in the logo.

questions.question: Which chocolate brand has a purple cow?
questions.fact: Milka's name comes from "Milch" and "Kakao", German for milk and cocoa. The purple cow first appeared in 1973.

questions.question: Which German chocolate is famously square?
questions.fact: Ritter Sport is square so it fits in a sports jacket pocket without breaking.

questions.question: Which company makes Kinder Surprise eggs?
questions.fact: Kinder Surprise eggs launched in Italy in 1974. "Kinder" means "children" in German.

questions.question: Which clothing brand's logo is a small crocodile?
questions.fact: René Lacoste was a French tennis champion nicknamed "the Crocodile", which inspired the logo.

questions.question: What is on the Ralph Lauren logo?
options: A polo player on a horse
questions.fact: Ralph Lauren was born Ralph Lifshitz in New York and started out selling ties.

questions.question: Which tech company's logo is four coloured squares?
questions.fact: The four colours are often said to stand for Microsoft's main products: Windows, Office, Xbox and Bing.

questions.question: Desigual, known for colourful patterns, comes from which city?
questions.fact: Desigual was founded in 1984. Its name means "unequal" or "different" in Spanish.

questions.question: Which company has owned Converse since 2003?
questions.fact: Converse's famous Chuck Taylor All Star trainers were first made for basketball in the 1910s and 20s.
